summary: Loads a custom C++ SOP plugin that generates CPU geometry or GPU-direct geometry through the plugin's SOP classes.

key_params.name: unloadplugin
key_params.note: Unload the plugin binary when all SOPs using it can release it.

common_gotchas: GPU-direct SOP output cannot be accessed by SOP to DAT or SOP to CHOP style readback paths.
Unloading a plugin requires every SOP using the same plugin to release it.
The official operator name and docs URL use `CPlusPlus`, not `C++`.
key_concepts: CPlusPlus SOP loads a compiled custom C++ SOP plugin rather than scripted Python geometry.
Plugin code chooses CPU output or GPU-direct output through the SOP plugin implementation.
CPU mode can use wired SOP inputs and supports downstream SOP readback paths; GPU-direct mode writes VBO buffers for rendering.
A loaded plugin can create custom parameters and must be reinitialized or unloaded when plugin code changes.
